one_liner: Nifty 50 declines amid mixed sectoral performance and negative market breadth.

drivers.title: Market Breadth
drivers.detail: Market breadth was negative with 1,437 declines.

flows_line: FIIs sold Rs 123.19 Cr, while DIIs bought Rs 1,349.64 Cr.
watch_next: Tomorrow, watch for GIFT Nifty trading at 23,713.5, a 78.4-point premium.
lesson_seeds: Pharma sector showed resilience with a 0.77% gain.
Financial services and IT sectors dragged the market down.
Market breadth was negative with more declines than advances.
